The 404 body follows the project's error-format convention. It's built with `errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", ...)`, so it comes back as RFC 7807 `application/problem+json`, like the other endpoints. The `detail` field reads "No invoice with id <id>".

I didn't add a test for the 404 case. Nothing durable came up that needs saving to memory.
